headline: Zinc Miners Nexa Resources and Buenaventura Advance Following Recent Losses
summary: Zinc miners bounced following weeks of declines, with Nexa Resources gaining 3.16% to USD 11.43 and Buenaventura rising 1.63% to USD 26.85.
why: Base metal producers exhibit high beta relative to industrial commodity price trends and broader macroeconomic growth expectations.

impacts.name: Nexa Resources SA
impacts.why: Nexa shares gained in step with a bounce across zinc miners.
